# A standard-library-provenance package keeps the 32-byte
# variable-make stack buffer at O2 and O3, while a user package
# uses the tier buffer. Provenance follows the std gate: the probe
# compiles as the external test package of a dotless import path,
# which the gate treats as standard provenance.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GO111MODULE=off
env GOPATH=$WORK/gopath

env WANT_STACKBUF=32
mkdir $WORK/gopath/src/probe
cp probe/probe.go probe/probe_test.go $WORK/gopath/src/probe/
mkdir $WORK/m
cp m/go.mod m/user_test.go m/logos.toml $WORK/m/
cd $WORK/gopath/src/probe
go test -count=1 -O=2 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'
go test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

env GO111MODULE=auto
cd $WORK/m
env WANT_STACKBUF=256
go test -count=1 -O=2 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'
env WANT_STACKBUF=4096
go test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'
logos test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

-- probe/probe.go --
package probe

-- probe/probe_test.go --
package probe_test

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

//go:noinline
func localProbe(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 1
	return b[n-1]
}

func allocs(n int) float64 {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = localProbe(n) })
}

func TestStdBuffer(t *testing.T) {
	want, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	if err != nil || want < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("WANT_STACKBUF=%q: want a byte count of at least 2", os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		n     int
		stack bool
	}{
		{want / 2, true},
		{want, true},
		{want + 1, false},
		{2*want + 1, false},
	} {
		if got := allocs(c.n); (got == 0) != c.stack {
			t.Errorf("make of %d bytes took %v allocations, want the std buffer of %d bytes to decide: stack=%v", c.n, got, want, c.stack)
		}
	}
}

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/stdbufuser

go 1.27

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- m/user_test.go --
package user

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

//go:noinline
func userProbe(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 1
	return b[n-1]
}

func userAllocs(n int) float64 {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = userProbe(n) })
}

func TestUserBuffer(t *testing.T) {
	want, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	if err != nil || want < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("WANT_STACKBUF=%q: want a byte count of at least 2", os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		n     int
		stack bool
	}{
		{want / 2, true},
		{want, true},
		{want + 1, false},
		{2*want + 1, false},
	} {
		if got := userAllocs(c.n); (got == 0) != c.stack {
			t.Errorf("make of %d bytes took %v allocations, want the tier buffer of %d bytes to decide: stack=%v", c.n, got, want, c.stack)
		}
	}
}
